_note: Chapter 24 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: The only access to the garden is through the old gate.
ex.cn: 通往花园的唯一入口是那道旧门。
ex.note: have access to 有权进入/使用；gain access to 获得进入…的机会

ex.en: Students can access the library database from any computer on campus.
ex.cn: 学生可以在校园里的任何一台电脑上访问图书馆数据库。
ex.note: access the Internet 上网；数据存取

ex.en: The police took immediate action after the accident.
ex.cn: 事故发生后，警察立即采取了行动。
ex.note: take action 采取行动；in action 在行动中

ex.en: She asked me for my advice before making the decision.
ex.cn: 做决定之前，她向我要了建议。
ex.note: ask for advice 征求意见；a piece of advice 一条建议

ex.en: The fire alarm sounded before anyone had noticed the smoke.
ex.cn: 还没人注意到烟雾，火警就响了。
ex.note: raise the alarm 发出警报；in alarm 惊慌地

ex.en: The sudden noise alarmed the baby.
ex.cn: 突然的响声吓着了婴儿。
ex.note: alarm sb. 使某人惊恐

ex.en: She stayed calm amid the noise and confusion.
ex.cn: 在一片喧闹和混乱之中，她保持着镇定。
ex.note: amid the noise 在喧闹声之中

ex.en: He was anxious about the first day at work.
ex.cn: 他心里对上班第一天颇为焦虑。
ex.note: be anxious about/for 为…焦虑；anxious to do 急着要做

ex.en: The plan will not go ahead without the board's approval.
ex.cn: 没有董事会的批准，这个计划就无法推进。
ex.note: give approval 给予批准；seek approval 寻求批准

ex.en: She was ashamed of how she had spoken to her friend.
ex.cn: 她为自己对朋友说话的方式感到羞愧。
ex.note: be ashamed of 为…感到羞愧

ex.en: She attended every training session and took careful notes.
ex.cn: 她参加了每一次培训，认真做了笔记。
ex.note: attend a meeting 出席会议；attend to 照料

ex.en: The old farmer leaned on his ax while he talked.
ex.cn: 老农一边说话，一边倚着他的斧子。
ex.note: an ax and a pick 一把斧子一把镐

ex.en: The wine sat in oak barrels in the cool cellar.
ex.cn: 酒放在阴凉的地窖里的橡木桶中。
ex.note: a barrel of oil 一桶石油

ex.en: The flower beds along the path were full of new seedlings.
ex.cn: 小路边的花坛里满是新长出的幼苗。
ex.note: river bed 河床；go to bed 就寝

ex.en: I bet he will forget all about it by tomorrow.
ex.cn: 我敢打赌，他到明天就把这事全忘了。
ex.note: you bet 当然；bet on 押注

ex.en: Bless you, my friend — you were a great help today.
ex.cn: 愿你平安，我的朋友——你今天帮了大忙。
ex.note: bless oneself 以…自居（贬义）

ex.en: She is the boss of a small design studio.
ex.cn: 她是一家小型设计工作室的老板。
ex.note: ask the boss for a raise 向老板要求加薪

ex.en: The hall was bright and full of noise.
ex.cn: 大厅里明亮而喧闹。
ex.note: a bright idea 好主意；look bright 看起来容光焕发

ex.en: He put butter and jam on his warm bread.
ex.cn: 他在温热的面包上抹了黄油和果酱。
ex.note: butter sb. up 奉承某人

ex.en: A single candle burned on the table during the blackout.
ex.cn: 停电时，桌上燃着一支蜡烛。
ex.note: burn the candle at both ends 过度消耗自己

ex.en: Most visitors came in casual clothes.
ex.cn: 大多数参观者都穿得很随意。
ex.note: casual wear 休闲服装；a casual attitude 随意的态度

ex.en: He drew a picture of a dragon in chalk on a small board.
ex.cn: 他用粉笔在一块小板上画了一条龙。
ex.note: chalk and cheese 毫不相干

ex.en: A wooden chest in the corner held the museum's oldest coins.
ex.cn: 角落里的一只木箱装着博物馆最古老的钱币。
ex.note: chest of drawers 五斗柜；chest freezer 冷冻柜

ex.en: The panel described how civilians and soldiers lived during the war.
ex.cn: 那块展板描述了战争中平民和士兵的生活。
ex.note: civilian clothes 便装；civilian life 平民生活

ex.en: By dusk the sky was cloudy and the air had turned cold.
ex.cn: 到了黄昏，天空多云起来，空气也变冷了。
ex.note: cloudy weather 多云天气

ex.en: They put on a short puppet comedy for the children.
ex.cn: 他们为孩子们演了一出短短的木偶喜剧。
ex.note: a comedy of errors 闹剧；sit comedy 情景喜剧

ex.en: Several visitors complained that the label was too political.
ex.cn: 好几位参观者抱怨说，那块展签太有政治色彩。
ex.note: complain about 抱怨；complain of 抱怨…（症状）

ex.en: The old chair was in poor condition after years of use.
ex.cn: 这把旧椅子用了多年，已经很破旧了。
ex.note: in good condition 状况良好；on condition that 条件是

ex.en: The training conditioned him to speak in front of crowds.
ex.cn: 培训让他习惯了在众人面前讲话。
ex.note: condition sb. to do 使某人习惯做某事

ex.en: The staff took her fear into consideration and called a doctor.
ex.cn: 工作人员体谅她的担心，叫来了医生。
ex.note: take sth. into consideration 考虑；on consideration 经考虑

ex.en: One label in the exhibition became controversial.
ex.cn: 展览里有一块展签引起了争议。
ex.note: a controversial issue 争议话题

ex.en: Ignoring the alarm system is a costly mistake.
ex.cn: 不重视警报系统是个代价高昂的错误。
ex.note: costly to sb. 对…代价高昂

ex.en: There was a table with pancakes, butter and cream.
ex.cn: 有一张桌子摆着薄煎饼、黄油和奶油。
ex.note: ice cream 冰淇淋；the cream of the crop 最优秀的人或物

ex.en: The section on culture and religion was the smallest in the show.
ex.cn: 关于文化与宗教的那一节是整个展览中最小的部分。
ex.note: culture shock 文化冲击；corporate culture 企业文化

ex.en: The old couple called each other 'darling' in public.
ex.cn: 那对老夫妻当众互称“亲爱的”。
ex.note: my darling 亲爱的（昵称）

ex.en: He declined the offer of a free guide's pass.
ex.cn: 他婉拒了那张免费的讲解员通行证。
ex.note: decline to do 婉拒做；decline an offer 拒绝提议

ex.en: Attendance showed a steady decline over the summer months.
ex.cn: 入夏以来，参观人数持续下降。
ex.note: a sharp decline 急剧下降；on the decline 在下降中

ex.en: The museum has a dentist's chair from an old surgery.
ex.cn: 博物馆里有一把旧诊所的牙医椅。
ex.note: go to the dentist 看牙医

ex.en: The smoke detector detected the steam and set off the alarm.
ex.cn: 烟雾探测器探测到蒸汽，触发了警报。
ex.note: detect a problem 发现问题；detect crime 侦破罪行

ex.en: A digital screen in the energy room shows how solar panels work.
ex.cn: 能源厅里的数码屏幕展示太阳能板如何工作。
ex.note: digital camera 数码相机；digital divide 数字鸿沟

ex.en: Models of a germ and a virus explain how disease spreads.
ex.cn: 细菌和病毒的模型解释了疾病如何传播。
ex.note: a chronic disease 慢性病；prevent disease 预防疾病

ex.en: What do you want to do after the tour is over?
ex.cn: 讲解结束后你想做什么？
ex.note: do sth. for sb. 为某人做某事；have nothing to do with 与…无关

ex.en: A mechanical dragon turned its head and opened its mouth.
ex.cn: 一条机械龙转过头，张开了嘴。
ex.note: Chinese dragon 中国龙；like a dragon 像龙一样

ex.en: The solar lamps along the path came on at dusk.
ex.cn: 小路边的太阳能灯在黄昏时亮了起来。
ex.note: at dusk 黄昏时；before dusk 天黑之前

ex.en: The campus paper's editor called on Monday.
ex.cn: 校报的编辑在周一打来了电话。
ex.note: editor-in-chief 主编；the editor's decision 编辑的决定

ex.en: The program welcomed children from six to eleven.
ex.cn: 这个项目招收六岁到十一岁的孩子。
ex.note: eleven o'clock 十一点钟

ex.en: The children could not endure sitting still for long.
ex.cn: 孩子们没法长时间安安静静地坐着。
ex.note: endure pain 忍受痛苦；endure to the end 坚持到底

ex.en: The children understood the equation of old and new.
ex.cn: 孩子们理解了新旧之间的那个等式。
ex.note: balance the equation 配平方程式；an equation of state 状态方程

ex.en: Evidently the boy had slipped away while she was reading a label.
ex.cn: 显然，她读展签的时候，男孩溜走了。
ex.note: evidently so 看来如此

ex.en: The fire officer inspected every exit and the alarm system.
ex.cn: 消防官检查了每一个出口和警报系统。
ex.note: the emergency exit 安全出口；exit sign 出口标志

ex.en: All visitors must exit through the main gate.
ex.cn: 所有参观者都必须从正门出去。
ex.note: exit from 从…退出；exit visa 退境签证

ex.en: The woman's eyesight was poor, so he read the labels to her.
ex.cn: 老太太眼神不好，于是他替她念展签。
ex.note: poor eyesight 视力差；improve eyesight 恢复视力

ex.en: The rural farm room shows what life was like a century ago.
ex.cn: 乡村农舍厅展示了一个世纪前的生活。
ex.note: a pig farm 养猪场；farm animals 农场牲畜

ex.en: His family has farmed this land for three generations.
ex.cn: 他家在这片土地上务农已经三代了。
ex.note: farm out 把…外包出去

ex.en: I felt that the museum had changed me.
ex.cn: 我感到博物馆改变了我。
ex.note: feel like doing 想要做；feel that … 觉得

ex.en: The weather was fine and the sky was clear.
ex.cn: 天气晴朗，天上没有一丝云。
ex.note: feel fine 感觉很好；a fine line 一条细线

ex.en: The company paid a heavy fine for breaking the safety rules.
ex.cn: 公司因违反安全规定而被处以重罚。
ex.note: pay a fine 交纳罚款

ex.en: The court fined the driver heavily for speeding.
ex.cn: 法庭因超速对那名司机处以重罚。
ex.note: fine sb. for sth. 因某事对某人罚款

ex.en: One child had a slight flu and wore a mask.
ex.cn: 有一个孩子得了轻微的流感，戴着口罩。
ex.note: catch the flu 得了流感；flu shot 流感疫苗

ex.en: Please fill in the form and hand it back to the desk.
ex.cn: 请填好表格，交回服务台。
ex.note: in the form of 以…的形式；fill in a form 填表

ex.en: A close group of friends formed around the guide.
ex.cn: 一群亲近的朋友围着讲解员聚拢过来。
ex.note: form a habit 养成习惯；form part of 构成…的一部分

ex.en: A friend from the drama club put on a puppet show.
ex.cn: 戏剧社的一位朋友演了一场木偶戏。
ex.note: a friend of mine 我的朋友；be friends with 与…是朋友

ex.en: The drawings went on display in the gallery.
ex.cn: 这些画在展厅里展出。
ex.note: an art gallery 美术馆；the press gallery 记者席

ex.en: A large model of a germ explained how disease spreads.
ex.cn: 一个巨大的细菌模型解释了疾病如何传播。
ex.note: a germ of doubt 一丝疑虑

ex.en: Tourists bought goods in the shop near the entrance.
ex.cn: 游客们在入口附近的商店里买了些东西。
ex.note: consumer goods 消费品；a goods train 货运列车

ex.en: The program was a great success.
ex.cn: 这个项目大获成功。
ex.note: a great deal of 大量的；great-grandparents 曾祖父母

ex.en: He found a habit of looking at people, not only objects.
ex.cn: 他养成了看人而不只是看物的习惯。
ex.note: be in the habit of 有…的习惯；break a habit 戒掉一个习惯

ex.en: She was carrying a suitcase and a hat.
ex.cn: 她手里提着一只行李箱和一顶帽子。
ex.note: put on / take off a hat 戴上/脱下帽子

ex.en: The staff were helpful when a child fell and hurt his lip.
ex.cn: 一个孩子摔倒磕破嘴唇时，工作人员表现得热心而有序。
ex.note: be helpful to sb. 对某人有用；乐于助人

ex.en: Guiding tours at the museum became more than a hobby.
ex.cn: 在博物馆做讲解已经不只是个爱好了。
ex.note: take up a hobby 培养一种爱好

ex.en: A traditional wooden house stands in the rural room.
ex.cn: 乡村农舍厅里立着一座传统木屋。
ex.note: a publishing house 出版社；the housing market 房地产市场

ex.en: The museum houses a collection of old farm tools.
ex.cn: 博物馆收藏了一批旧农具。
ex.note: house a collection 收藏；be housed in 坐落在

ex.en: He laughed at the idiom 'use a word as a verb'.
ex.cn: 他被“把一个词当动词用”这个说法逗笑了。
ex.note: an English idiom 英语习语；speak in idioms 说习语

ex.en: It seemed impossible to keep order in the hall.
ex.cn: 要维持大厅里的秩序似乎不可能。
ex.note: impossible to do 不可能做；next to impossible 几乎不可能

ex.en: An old-fashioned infant's bed is displayed in the town room.
ex.cn: 城镇厅里陈列着一张老式的婴儿床。
ex.note: infant care 婴儿护理；infant mortality 婴儿死亡率

ex.en: An officer inspected the exit and the alarm system.
ex.cn: 一名警官检查了出口和警报系统。
ex.note: inspect sth. for sth. 检查…是否有…

ex.en: David learned the internal door that led to the tunnel.
ex.cn: 大卫记住了那道通往隧道的内门。
ex.note: internal affairs 内务；internal organs 内脏

ex.en: His jacket was fine, but the cut on his lip was not.
ex.cn: 他的夹克倒还好，嘴唇上的伤口却不是。
ex.note: a leather jacket 皮夹克；a dust jacket 防尘罩

ex.en: A jury box from an old court stands in the town room.
ex.cn: 城镇厅里摆着一只旧法庭的陪审团席。
ex.note: the jury 陪审团；a jury of peers 同侪评审团

ex.en: Every object in the museum has a small label beside it.
ex.cn: 博物馆里的每件展品旁边都有一张小标签。
ex.note: a warning label 警示标签；read the label 阅读标签

ex.en: Many people label modern art as meaningless.
ex.cn: 许多人说现代艺术毫无意义。
ex.note: label sb. as 把某人称为

ex.en: A lawyer's desk from the last century is on display.
ex.cn: 展出的东西里有一张上世纪的律师办公桌。
ex.note: consult a lawyer 咨询律师

ex.en: He cleaned a lens of his glasses with his sleeve.
ex.cn: 他用袖子擦了擦眼镜的一片镜片。
ex.note: a camera lens 相机镜头；through a lens 透过镜片

ex.en: The boy cut his lip when he slipped on the ramp.
ex.cn: 男孩在斜坡上滑倒，磕破了嘴唇。
ex.note: keep one's lips sealed 守口如瓶；the upper lip 上唇

ex.en: David loosened the boy's collar so he could breathe.
ex.cn: 大卫松开男孩的衣领，好让他顺畅呼吸。
ex.note: loosen up 放松；loosen one's grip 松开手

ex.en: A maid's uniform from 1900 hangs beside the door.
ex.cn: 一件一九〇〇年的女仆制服挂在门边。
ex.note: a maid of honor 总统女侍；house maid 家庭女佣

ex.en: They had been married for fifty years.
ex.cn: 他们结婚已经五十年了。
ex.note: marry sb. 嫁给某人；be married to 与…结婚

ex.en: The media attention pleased the board.
ex.cn: 媒体的关注让董事会很满意。
ex.note: social media 社交媒体；media coverage 媒体报道

ex.en: The weather was mild and the sky was clear.
ex.cn: 天气温和，天空晴朗。
ex.note: mild winter 温和的冬天；mild pain 轻微的疼痛

ex.en: He adjusted the screen's mode with a single touch.
ex.cn: 他轻触一下就调出了屏幕的模式。
ex.note: in this mode 在这种模式下；mode of transport 交通方式

ex.en: A mechanical dragon with a motor in its chest turned its head.
ex.cn: 一条胸口装着马达的机械龙转了转头。
ex.note: an electric motor 电动机；motor vehicle 机动车

ex.en: The rooms come in a clear order, namely: farm, town, health and energy.
ex.cn: 这几个展厅有清晰的次序，即：农舍、城镇、健康和能源。
ex.note: namely 即；也就是（后接解释）

ex.en: David felt nervous, and his voice shook at the start.
ex.cn: 大卫有些紧张，开头时声音都在发抖。
ex.note: be nervous about 对…感到紧张；be nervous of 害怕

ex.en: Neither the children nor the parents complained about the fire drill.
ex.cn: 孩子和父母对这次消防演练都没有抱怨。
ex.note: neither … nor … 既不…也不…

ex.en: Our objective is not to preach but to show.
ex.cn: 我们的目的不是说教，而是展示。
ex.note: the main objective 主要目标；reach an objective 达成目标

ex.en: The panel tried to stay objective about the war.
ex.cn: 那块展板努力对这场战争保持客观。
ex.note: an objective account 客观的叙述

ex.en: It's okay — we will take care of him.
ex.cn: 没事的——我们会照看好他。
ex.note: Are you okay? 你还好吗？；okay 好的/行

ex.en: The objects are arranged in a special order.
ex.cn: 这些展品按一种特别的顺序排列。
ex.note: in order to 为了；place an order 下订单

ex.en: He ordered the room so that the guide could stand at the front.
ex.cn: 他整理好房间，让讲解员能站在前面。
ex.note: order sb. to do 命令某人做；order a ticket 订票

ex.en: The overall impression of the exhibition was excellent.
ex.cn: 这场展览给人的总体印象非常好。
ex.note: the overall cost 总成本；overall quality 整体质量

ex.en: Overall, the program was a success.
ex.cn: 总的来说，这个项目是成功的。
ex.note: overall speaking 总的来说

ex.en: He wore a pair of blue overalls while he worked in the garden.
ex.cn: 他在花园干活时穿着一身蓝色工装。
ex.note: a pair of overalls 一套工装裤

ex.en: There was a table with pancakes, butter and cream.
ex.cn: 有一张桌子摆着薄煎饼、黄油和奶油。
ex.note: make pancakes 做煎饼；like a pancake 摊得平平的

ex.en: Guiding tours turned out to be a pastime that pays.
ex.cn: 事实证明，做讲解是一份能挣钱的消遣。
ex.note: a popular pastime 受欢迎的消遣

ex.en: By the first week, forty percent of the places were booked.
ex.cn: 到了第一周末，百分之四十的名额就被预订了。
ex.note: percent of … …的百分之…；a large percentage of 很大一部分

ex.en: Physical models of a germ and a virus explained disease.
ex.cn: 细菌和病毒的实体模型把疾病讲清楚了。
ex.note: physical education 体育；physical health 身体健康

ex.en: A new plant on the edge of town makes the solar panels for the museum.
ex.cn: 城边新建成的那家工厂为博物馆生产太阳能板。
ex.note: a power plant 发电厂；plant life 植物群

ex.en: The gardener planted a young tree in the flower bed.
ex.cn: 园丁在花坛里栽下一棵小树。
ex.note: plant trees 植树；plant an idea 树立观念

ex.en: A visitor complained that the panel was too political.
ex.cn: 一位参观者抱怨那块展板太有政治色彩。
ex.note: political party 政党；political science 政治学

ex.en: He hung a poster for the show in the corridor.
ex.cn: 他在走廊里挂了一张展览海报。
ex.note: a campaign poster 宣传海报；post a poster 张贴海报

ex.en: The doctor cleaned the cut and prescribed nothing.
ex.cn: 医生清理了伤口，什么药也没开。
ex.note: prescribe sth. for sb. 给某人开某药；prescribe rules 规定规则

ex.en: The prize was a small book, and every child received one.
ex.cn: 奖品是一本小书，每个孩子都得到了一本。
ex.note: win a prize 获奖；first prize 一等奖

ex.en: She prized the old photograph more than any treasure.
ex.cn: 她把那张旧照片看得比任何珍宝都珍贵。
ex.note: prize sth. highly 珍视；prize over 胜过

ex.en: His boss had a proposal for the museum.
ex.cn: 他的上司为博物馆提出了一个方案。
ex.note: make a proposal 提出建议；a proposal of marriage 求婚

ex.en: He could feel pure joy when the children called him the best guide.
ex.cn: 当孩子们称他为最好的讲解员时，他感到了纯粹的喜悦。
ex.note: pure water 纯净水；purely by chance 完全出于偶然

ex.en: He slipped on the ramp by the rail.
ex.cn: 他在栏杆旁的斜坡上滑了一跤。
ex.note: handrail 扶手；railway 铁路

ex.en: He realized that the museum had changed him.
ex.cn: 他意识到博物馆改变了他。
ex.note: realize that … 意识到；realize one's potential 发挥潜能

ex.en: The reflection of the solar lamps in the windows looked like small moons.
ex.cn: 太阳能灯映在窗玻璃上的倒影，像一轮轮小月亮。
ex.note: a reflection in the water 水中的倒影；a reflection on 对…的反映

ex.en: The section on culture and religion was too small.
ex.cn: 关于文化与宗教的那一节太小了。
ex.note: religious freedom 宗教自由

ex.en: The mother was grateful for the rescue.
ex.cn: 那位母亲对这次营救心怀感激。
ex.note: rescue sb. from 把某人从…中救出；come to the rescue 前来救援

ex.en: A guide must never retreat from a crying child.
ex.cn: 讲解员绝不能对一个哭泣的孩子退却。
ex.note: retreat from 从…撤退；a strategic retreat 战略退却

ex.en: A robot beside the dragon drew circles on a screen.
ex.cn: 龙旁边的一个机器人在屏幕上画圆圈。
ex.note: a robot arm 机械臂；robot vacuum 扫地机器人

ex.en: The rural farm room shows how people lived in the countryside.
ex.cn: 乡村农舍厅展示了农村人过去的生活。
ex.note: rural area 农村地区；rural life 乡村生活

ex.en: The bright idea saved the museum from a dull exhibit.
ex.cn: 这个好点子让博物馆避开了一场乏味的展览。
ex.note: save time 节省时间；save money 省钱

ex.en: A digital screen shows how the solar panel works.
ex.cn: 一块数码屏幕展示太阳能板如何工作。
ex.note: a cinema screen 电影银幕；screen door 纱门

ex.en: All the children were screened for flu before the tour.
ex.cn: 讲解之前，所有孩子都做了流感筛查。
ex.note: screen for 筛查；screen from 遮挡

ex.en: He used his radio to send a colleague for the first-aid kit.
ex.cn: 他用对讲机叫一位同事去取急救箱。
ex.note: send for 派人去叫；send away 派遣

ex.en: A shallow cream bowl sits beside the wooden chest.
ex.cn: 一只浅浅的奶油碗摆在木箱旁边。
ex.note: shallow water 浅水；shallow thinking 肤浅的思维

ex.en: The children shouted with delight when the dragon moved.
ex.cn: 那条龙一动，孩子们欣喜地大叫起来。
ex.note: shout for help 大声呼救；shout at 对…大喊

ex.en: A singer from the music club taught them a song.
ex.cn: 音乐社的一位歌手教他们唱了一首歌。
ex.note: an opera singer 歌剧演员

ex.en: A small boy slipped on the ramp and cut his lip.
ex.cn: 一个小男孩在斜坡上滑倒，磕破了嘴唇。
ex.note: slip away 溜走；slip into 溜进

ex.en: A slip of paper with the date was tucked under the cup.
ex.cn: 一张写着日期的纸条压在杯子下面。
ex.note: a slip of the tongue 口误；a slip of paper 一张小纸条

ex.en: A solar panel on the roof powers the lamps along the path.
ex.cn: 屋顶上的一块太阳能板为小路边的灯供电。
ex.note: solar energy 太阳能；the solar system 太阳系

ex.en: The staff began to sow seeds in the flower beds.
ex.cn: 工作人员开始在花坛里播种。
ex.note: sow seeds 播种；sow the seeds of discord 埋下不和的种子

ex.en: The robot could even spit soap bubbles.
ex.cn: 那个机器人甚至还会吐肥皂泡。
ex.note: spit out 吐出；spit at 朝…吐（唾沫）

ex.en: The program will start at ten on Saturday morning.
ex.cn: 项目将在周六上午十点开始。
ex.note: start doing 开始做；start off 出发

ex.en: It was a good start to the school year.
ex.cn: 这是新学年一个不错的开端。
ex.note: a head start 领先优势；from the start 从一开始

ex.en: A wooden stool stands next to the butter churn.
ex.cn: 黄油搅拌器旁边立着一张木凳。
ex.note: a three-legged stool 三条腿的凳子；stool pigeon 鸽类

ex.en: The structure of the tour is very simple.
ex.cn: 这次讲解的结构很简单。
ex.note: the structure of society 社会结构；a stone structure 石造建筑

ex.en: They structured the afternoon as a series of short games.
ex.cn: 他们把那个下午组织成一系列小游戏。
ex.note: structure A around B 以 B 为中心构建 A

ex.en: She was carrying a suitcase and a hat.
ex.cn: 她手里提着一只行李箱和一顶帽子。
ex.note: a leather suitcase 皮箱；pack a suitcase 收拾行李箱

ex.en: Trees surround the yard, and their leaves were new.
ex.cn: 树木环绕着院子，叶子都是新长出来的。
ex.note: be surrounded by 被…环绕；surround yourself with 与…为伴

ex.en: The dragon's tail moved slowly from side to side.
ex.cn: 龙的尾巴缓缓地左右摆动。
ex.note: turn your tail 逃跑；a tail wagging 尾巴摇摆

ex.en: He could tell that the children were learning.
ex.cn: 他看得出孩子们正在学习。
ex.note: tell sb. sth. 告诉某人某事；tell a lie 撒谎

ex.en: The drawing was theirs, and they wanted David to keep it.
ex.cn: 这幅画是他们的，他们想让大卫收下。
ex.note: yours / mine / ours / theirs 我的/我们的/他们的（东西）

ex.en: Parents used words like 'thoughtful' and 'wonderful' in the feedback forms.
ex.cn: 家长们在反馈表上用了“用心”“精彩”这样的词。
ex.note: a thoughtful remark 深思的话；be thoughtful of 对…体贴

ex.en: The children did not tire, though their parents did.
ex.cn: 孩子们不觉累，倒是他们的父母累了。
ex.note: tire of 厌倦；tire out 使筋疲力尽

ex.en: Tourists from other cities bought goods in the shop.
ex.cn: 外地来的游客在商店里买了东西。
ex.note: a tourist attraction 旅游景点；tourist season 旅游旺季

ex.en: The museum doctor treated the cut and prescribed nothing.
ex.cn: 博物馆的医生处理了伤口，什么药也没开。
ex.note: treat sb. to sth. 请某人吃…；treat of 论述

ex.en: The pancakes were a real treat for the children.
ex.cn: 那些煎饼对孩子来说真是一份享受。
ex.note: a treat to sb. 对某人来说是一份乐事；a special treat 特别的款待

ex.en: They led everyone through the tunnel to the yard.
ex.cn: 他们引导所有人穿过隧道来到院子。
ex.note: a tunnel under the river 河底隧道

ex.en: The panel about unemployment in the 1930s said almost nothing about ordinary families.
ex.cn: 那块讲二十世纪三十年代失业的展板几乎没提普通家庭。
ex.note: rising unemployment 失业率上升；unemployment benefit 失业救济金

ex.en: He used his radio to call a colleague for the first-aid kit.
ex.cn: 他用对讲机叫同事去拿急救箱。
ex.note: make use of 利用；use up 用完

ex.en: The label explains the use of each tool in the room.
ex.cn: 展签解释了展厅里每件工具的用途。
ex.note: be of no use 没用；out of use 废弃不用

ex.en: One parent wrote that her son now uses the word 'museum' as a verb.
ex.cn: 有位家长写道，她儿子现在把“博物馆”当动词用。
ex.note: a transitive verb 及物动词；the verb 'to be' 动词 be

ex.en: A visual map helped him find the emergency exit.
ex.cn: 一张导览图帮助他找到了安全出口。
ex.note: visual aids 视觉辅助；visual sense 视觉

ex.en: Do not waste time explaining what they can already see.
ex.cn: 别浪费时间去解释他们已经看得见的东西。
ex.note: waste money on 在…上浪费钱；a waste of time 浪费时间

ex.en: The waste from the old factory was cleared away last winter.
ex.cn: 去年冬天，旧工厂的废料被清走了。
ex.note: industrial waste 工业废料；waste disposal 废物处理

ex.en: They turned a piece of waste land behind the museum into a garden.
ex.cn: 他们把博物馆后面的一块荒地改成了花园。
ex.note: waste ground 荒地

ex.en: The program would welcome children from six to eleven.
ex.cn: 这个项目招收六岁到十一岁的孩子。
ex.note: welcome sb. to … 欢迎某人来到…；You're welcome 不客气

ex.en: The program was a welcome change for the museum.
ex.cn: 这个项目对博物馆来说是个受欢迎的变化。
ex.note: a welcome relief 受欢迎的宽慰；you're welcome to … 你尽管可以…

ex.en: Why do we keep old things?
ex.cn: 我们为什么要留着这些老东西？
ex.note: why not 为什么不；the reason why … …的原因

ex.en: Parents wrote that the guide had been wonderful.
ex.cn: 家长写道，这位讲解员棒极了。
ex.note: wonderful news 好消息；How wonderful! 太好了！

ex.en: The spring fair filled the yard in the museum.
ex.cn: 春季集市把博物馆的院子挤得满满的。
ex.note: a garden yard 庭院；a yard of cloth 一码布
